name: Infosys Ltd
about: Infosys Ltd provides consulting, technology, outsourcing and next-generation digital services to enable clients to execute strategies for their digital transformation.[1] It is the 2nd largest Information Technology company in India behind TCS.[2]
keyPoints: Digital Services: It comprises of services and solution offerings of the group that enables clients to transform their businesses. It includes offerings that enhance customer experience, leverage AI-based analytics and big data, engineer digital products and IoT, modernize legacy tech systems, migrate to cloud applications and implement advanced cyber-security systems.[1]
pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 4.37%.
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 30.8%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 68.5%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 42.0 days to 32.7 days

announcements.text: Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR Regulations 18 Nov - Infosys Singapore to invest JPY 1.59bn for 10.1% stake in NTT Docomo Playspace JV.
Change In Corporate Office Address Of The Company'S Registrar And Share Transfer Agent 18 Nov - Infosys reports KFin Technologies’ corporate office address change effective December 1, 2026.

Infosys Positioned As A Leader In The 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ For Public Cloud Optimization And Transformation Services For The Fourth Consecutive Year 17 Nov - Infosys named a Leader in Gartner 2026 Public Cloud Optimization and Transformation Services MQ for fourth straight year.
Six Promising Researchers Win The Infosys Prize 2026 Awarded By The Infosys Science Foundation 12 Nov - Infosys Science Foundation announces six winners of Infosys Prize 2026 on November 12, 2026.
Investor Conference 4 Nov - Infosys management to attend three investor events on Nov 16, 17 and 19, 2026 in Mumbai and Singapore.
